rows.dek_lead: Paul Thomas Anderson’s new film, “Phantom Thread,” is a virtual remake of his 2012 film “The Master.” Up until now, “The Master” was Anderson’s best film, but “Phantom Thread” is also, in many ways, an improvement on it.
